Buyer-safe statement: A native OpenShell OCSF event can be captured and bound to exact fields.
The same event produces the same canonical assurance claim.
A single changed bound field flips PASS to HOLD.
Relevant NET:OPEN stream events produce one receipt per native UID.
Duplicate events do not create duplicate state.
Registry and receipt hashes remain equal after processor restart.
A separate run rehydrates byte-identical registry artifact and appends exactly one new event.
No end-to-end cross-event correlation is claimed without provider-native correlation evidence.
This proof is demo-ready but not production admission.
ESS is not claimed to be equivalent or superior to NVIDIA OpenShell.
